fields.description: Weekly issue featuring editorials and local commentary on an anticipated real-estate upswing, housing affordability and apartment vacancies, wage levels and living conditions, and calls for cleanup and sanitation enforcement along the Miami River. Includes reporting on rum-running and the arrest of “Pop” Nesle, criticism of police conduct and uniforms being mistaken for Coast Guard, discussion of oil/natural gas drilling prospects near Miami, and coverage of local sports and entertainment (boxing cards, golf events), along with letters to the editor and extensive local advertising.
